newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Inparsa hits high, 1,850 esc resistance.
newsitem.headline: Inparsa hits high, 1,850 esc resistance.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese wood-to-tourism group Inparsa-SGPS may soon hit resistance of 1,850 escudos, after successive highs due to good prospects for results this year, bourse operators said.
Inparsa shares reached an all-time high of 1,825 escudos, up 3.3 percent, before easing back to 1,815 escudos in volume of 66,252 shares at 1406 GMT.
Dealers said that both Inparsa's Sonae Industria unit and Spanish company Tafisa, in which Sonae Industria holds a 49.97 percent stake, should present good half-year results.
"I think that the next resistance of Inparsa is at 1,850 escudos," said a dealer. "There has been a lot of demand for this stock because 1997 forecasts suggest a great year in the industry."
Some analysts have said that Inparsa was rising due to strong prospects for Sonae Industria's results.
Sonae Industria is expected to post a profit of between 1.3 and 1.5 billion escudos in 1997. Net profits after minority interests stood at 450 million escudos in 1996.

Inparsa combines the wood products businesses of Sonae Industria with the media, computing and tourism businesses of Pargeste, and was created after a March restructuring of the Sonae group. Inparsa holds 63 percent of the share capital of Sonae Industria.
Half year 1997 results of Inparsa and Sonae Industria will be released in mid-September.
